logic: Iterates over the collection `cartLines` (a list of ShoppingCartItem objects). For each item it invokes `cartItem.getItemSubTotal()` and adds the returned BigDecimal to an accumulator (`itemsTotal`). After processing all items the accumulator, which now holds the sum of every line‑item subtotal, is returned as the cart subtotal.
mathematical_formula: sub_total = Σ (itemSubTotal_i)  for i = 1 .. N  where N = number of cartLines
